ashwood_beam_2m.name: Ashwood Beam 2 m
ashwood_beam_2m.note: measured 2026-10-05: the pivot height looks wrong (outside the drawn size); measure again or check in game before relying on it

darkwood_gate.name: Darkwood Gate
darkwood_gate.note: 2 wide, 4 tall, pivot at the bottom (needs darkwood materials)

fire_pit.name: Campfire
fire_pit.note: a raycast straight up must hit a roof (underRoof) or rain puts it out; smoke needs a vent above

hearth.name: Hearth
hearth.note: 4 x 3 stone hearth; leave a ridge vent above it

iron_floor_1x1_v2.name: Cage Floor 1x1
iron_floor_1x1_v2.note: measured 2026-10-05: the pivot height looks wrong (outside the drawn size); measure again or check in game before relying on it

piece_banner01.name: Black Banner
piece_banner01.note: black banner, hangs below its pivot (top bar); thin along x, so it faces +-x at yaw 0; must touch what holds it

piece_cookingstation.name: Cooking Station
piece_cookingstation.note: fire check point 0.2 above the pivot: put the pivot on the fire's centre; three at yaw 0/60/120 share one campfire

piece_mistletoe.name: Mistletoe
piece_mistletoe.note: measured 2026-10-05: the pivot height looks wrong (outside the drawn size); measure again or check in game before relying on it

piece_workbench.name: Workbench
piece_workbench.note: front (work side) is +z; needs a roof above; extensions within 5 m

piece_workbench_ext1.name: Chopping Block
piece_workbench_ext1.note: chopping block; counts within 5 m of the workbench

piece_workbench_ext2.name: Tanning Rack
piece_workbench_ext2.note: tanning rack; counts within 5 m of the workbench

portal_wood.name: Portal
portal_wood.note: 3.3 m tall: does not fit under a 3 m ceiling; front +z

stake_wall.name: Stakewall
stake_wall.note: 2 wide, snaps 0..2 high but the points reach 3.5

stone_stair.name: Stone Stair
stone_stair.note: rises 1 toward local -z over 2 m; pivot at the bottom

wood_beam_26.name: Wood Beam 26°
wood_beam_26.note: runs along x rising toward +x (1 over 2); pivot at the low end height, centred along x

wood_beam_45.name: Wood Beam 45°
wood_beam_45.note: runs along x rising toward +x (2 over 2), centred

wood_fence.name: Roundpole Fence
wood_fence.note: 2 m along x but spans x -1.1..0.9: at yaw 0 the pivot is 0.1 east of the span centre

wood_fence_gate.name: Roundpole Gate
wood_fence_gate.note: spans x -1.2..0.8, pivot 1 above the bottom

wood_gate.name: Wood Gate
wood_gate.note: the taller wood door: 2 wide, 3 tall, pivot 1 above the bottom

wood_log_45.name: Log Beam 45°
wood_log_45.note: log version of wood_beam_45 (core wood); good for crossed gable horns

wood_roof.name: Thatch Roof 26°
wood_roof.note: 26 deg: rises 1 over 2 toward local -z; pivot at the low edge height

wood_roof_45.name: Thatch Roof 45°
wood_roof_45.note: rises toward local -z; plane through the pivot. yaw 270 rises to +x, 90 to -x, 180 to +z

wood_roof_top_45.name: Thatch Roof Ridge 45°
wood_roof_top_45.note: ridge along x, 1 above the pivot; eaves at z +-1 at pivot height. yaw 90: ridge along z

wood_stair.name: Wood Stairs
wood_stair.note: rises 1 toward local -z over 2 m; pivot at the bottom edge height. yaw 180 rises to +z

wood_stepladder.name: Wood Ladder
wood_stepladder.note: 1 wide, rises 2 toward local -z over 2 m (45 deg); pivot at the bottom centre

wood_wall_roof_45.name: Wood Wall 45°
wood_wall_roof_45.note: gable triangle, right angle at +x (tall side x=+1), pivot at the bottom centre; yaw 180 mirrors

wood_wall_roof_top_45.name: Wood Roof Cross 45°
wood_wall_roof_top_45.note: not a gable peak: a V (valley) wall, bottom y 0 at x +-1 and top y 2 at x +-1

wood_window.name: Wood Shutter
wood_window.note: 1x1 shutter (opens like a door) hinged at the pivot (x 0), spans x -1..0; yaw 180 spans 0..1
